correctness.rationale: Unique star/top containing each dimension>=2 face, a uniform non-equivariant descending elementary collapse to dimension two, the hypersimplex two-skeleton proof of simple connectivity, and the signed simplicial Euler identity prove the seven-term S_n-character for every n>=6 and 3<=k<=n-3. Correct reduced Euler equation is [1]+[Htilde_2]=sum_i(-1)^i[C_i]. The character has zero trivial and sign inner products by Frobenius reciprocity, so finite-group rational orbit homology is reduced-acyclic under S_n and A_n. Actual packaged Python verifier independently matches full fixed-face Lefschetz traces and the incidence-module formula for 70 conjugacy class representatives in four cases and mod-2 homology ranks. Finite computations are auxiliary, not universal proof. No unexplained nonstandard lemma or boundary case remains within the stated parameter range.

value.rationale: A complete natural S_n-representation family across every weight k, including all new k>=4, refines the previously known dimension-only sphere-wedge classification and supplies uniform rational-acyclic quotient results for both S_n and A_n. The group action is intrinsic to the Johnson/hypersimplex construction; the exact character is an invariant needed to distinguish symmetry quotients and equivariant topology. It is not a routine parameter substitution because the oriented-edge stabilizers, star/top flag orbit modules and alternating quotients must be computed equivariantly.
